source: User feedback supplied in conversation, preserved separately from browser scores and comments.
interpretation: These are qualitative comparative verdicts, not invented numerical scores or final game-ready acceptance. The dance feedback does not select one of the two MotionBricks variants.

observations.comment: Cleaned Recovery is the best, still needs work.
observations.requested_change: Cleaned recovery with a clean return to the default pose to help transitions.

observations.comment: MotionBricks/single poses and MotionBricks/motion windows led to gibberish movements.
Sumo stomp same; cleaned recovery best but needs some work.
observations.requested_change: Return to the default pose, with grounded, flat feet rather than floating feet.

observations.scope_note: The reviewer applied the preceding ukemi comparison to sumo stomp; no separate numerical scores were supplied.

observations.comment: Dance: here MotionBricks looks pretty good.
observations.scope_note: Feedback applies to the MotionBricks approaches as a family; an individual variant was not selected.

family_feedback.comment: Cleaned recovery could use more grounding and anchoring of the feet; they often flutter.
family_feedback.requested_change: Ground and anchor supporting feet and provide a clean default-pose transition.
family_feedback.implementation_note: The cleanup plan must retain intentional lifted feet and non-foot support during rolls.
